text: 4. By the action of heat it undergoes the waters fufen, the water is driven off, and it becomes dry. It is decompiled in a throat, gives out a little oxygen gas, then nitrous gas, and at all the nitric acid. The pure earth remains behind.

parsed.faithful: 4. By the action of heat it undergoes the watery fufion; the water is driven off, and it becomes dry. It is decomposed in a strong heat, gives out a little oxygen gas, then nitrous gas, and at last the nitric acid. The pure earth remains behind.
